entries.meaningZh: 反日〔复数形式，气象光象〕
entries.en: The photographer compared images of anthelia taken on different expeditions.
entries.zh: 摄影师比较了在不同探险途中拍摄的反日照片。

entries.en: The sculptor deepened the shadow beneath the anthelix on the clay ear.
entries.zh: 雕塑家加深了黏土耳朵上对耳轮下方的阴影。

entries.en: The student drew the antheridia in pencil, then marked their positions on a larger sketch.
entries.zh: 学生用铅笔画出精子囊，再在一张更大的草图上标明它们的位置。

entries.en: Anthes slipped a folded menu under the short table leg to stop it rocking.
entries.zh: 安特斯把折好的菜单塞在较短的桌腿下，让桌子不再晃动。

entries.en: The laboratory ordered another anthocyanidin standard after discovering that the original vial had leaked.
entries.zh: 实验室发现原来的小瓶漏液后，又订购了一份花色素标准品。

entries.en: Her report compared anthocyanins from several samples without claiming that their concentrations were identical.
entries.zh: 她的报告比较了几份样品中的花青素，并未声称它们的浓度相同。

entries.en: Her anthomania filled every sunny windowsill with pots, leaving no room for the cat.
entries.zh: 她对花的痴迷让每个向阳的窗台都摆满了花盆，连猫待的地方也没了。

entries.en: The anthomaniac returned from the market with lilies instead of the onions she had promised to buy.
entries.zh: 那位花迷从市场带回的是百合花，而不是她答应买的洋葱。

entries.en: Anthon caught the rolling orange before it reached the gap beneath the kitchen cupboard.
entries.zh: 安东在橙子滚进厨房橱柜下面的缝隙前抓住了它。

entries.en: The researcher recorded anthophagy when the beetle began eating the petals instead of the leaves.
entries.zh: 甲虫开始吃花瓣而不是叶片时，研究人员记录了这种食花行为。

entries.en: Anthos brought a spare pair of socks after hearing that the river path was flooded.
entries.zh: 安托斯听说河边小路被淹了，便多带了一双袜子。

entries.en: The geologist compared the two samples before revising her estimate of the extent of anthracitization.
entries.zh: 地质学家比较了两份样品后，修改了对无烟煤化程度的估计。

entries.en: The anthranol sample remained in its original container while the laboratory investigated the damaged label.
entries.zh: 实验室调查标签为何受损期间，那份蒽酚样品仍保存在原来的容器中。

entries.en: I swapped my morning anthro seminar for an afternoon session so that I could keep my job.
entries.zh: 我把上午的人类学研讨课换到了下午，这样就能保住工作。

entries.en: The missing bottle of anthrone turned up in the wrong cupboard during the stock check.
entries.zh: 库存检查时，人们找到了那瓶不见的蒽酮，原来它被放错了橱柜。

entries.en: The library moved its anthropobiology books upstairs while the ground-floor shelves were being replaced.
entries.zh: 更换一楼书架期间，图书馆把人类生物学书籍搬到了楼上。

entries.en: The museum's discussion of the Anthropocene prompted visitors to reconsider the history of the city.
entries.zh: 博物馆关于人类世的讨论促使访客重新思考这座城市的历史。

entries.en: The seeds in the boot treads gave the team a practical question about anthropochory.
entries.zh: 靴底纹路里的种子给团队提出了一个有关人为散布的实际问题。

entries.en: Her course in anthropogeography led her to compare old settlement maps with railway timetables.
entries.zh: 人文地理分布学课程促使她把旧聚落地图与铁路时刻表作比较。

entries.en: The scholar's work in anthropography relied on travellers' diaries, which she treated with considerable caution.
entries.zh: 那位学者的人类地理分布学研究依赖旅行者的日记，而她对这些日记持相当谨慎的态度。

entries.en: The anthropometrist asked the volunteers to wait while she checked the measuring equipment.
entries.zh: 人体测量学家请志愿者们稍候，让她先检查一下测量设备。

entries.en: The anthropomorphist pictured the deity seated at a table, while his opponent rejected any human form.
entries.zh: 那位拟人论者设想神坐在桌旁，而他的对手拒绝赋予神任何人的形体。

entries.en: The film's three anthropomorphoses required different costumes for the wolf, the tree and the river.
entries.zh: 影片中狼、树和河流三次化为人形的场景，需要使用不同的服装。

entries.en: The puppet's anthropomorphosis happened behind a curtain, leaving the audience to imagine the change.
entries.zh: 木偶化为人形的过程发生在幕布后，让观众自行想象这一变化。

entries.en: The anthroponym in the surname column had been copied incorrectly from the older register.
entries.zh: 姓氏一栏中的那个姓，从较早的登记册抄录时抄错了。

entries.en: The poem's anthropopathism became evident when its god grew jealous of a painted statue.
entries.zh: 诗中写到神嫉妒一尊彩绘雕像时，显露出了神人同感说的倾向。

entries.en: The lecturer questioned the poet's anthropopathy but admired the imagery of the grieving mountain.
entries.zh: 讲师对诗人的神或事物与人同感论持有疑问，却赞赏那座悲伤的山所构成的意象。

entries.en: The novelist removed the anthropophagi from her fantasy story and gave the travellers a different danger.
entries.zh: 小说家删去了奇幻故事中的食人肉者，给旅行者们安排了另一种危险。

entries.meaningZh: 对人的恐惧〔心理学用语〕
entries.en: Anthropophobia made the crowded waiting room difficult for her, so she asked to wait somewhere quieter.
entries.zh: 对人的恐惧让她难以待在拥挤的候诊室里，于是她请求换个更安静的地方等候。

entries.en: The detective in the novel rejected anthroposcopy and insisted on checking the accounts instead.
entries.zh: 小说中的侦探不信相面术，坚持要核查账目。

entries.meaningZh: 人智学研究者或实践者
entries.en: The anthroposophist lent me a book, then invited me to question its assumptions at our next meeting.
entries.zh: 那位人智学研究者借给我一本书，并邀请我在下次见面时质疑书中的假设。

entries.meaningZh: 人智学研究者或实践者〔复数用法〕
entries.en: The anthroposophists disagreed about the exhibition's introduction and rewrote it together before the opening.
entries.zh: 那些人智学研究者对展览的介绍意见不一，便在开幕前共同重写了介绍。

entries.en: Her diagram of the anthroposphere included the abandoned industrial district as well as the working farms.
entries.zh: 她的人类圈示意图既包括废弃工业区，也包括仍在经营的农场。

entries.en: The guide compared drawings of two Anthus species because the photograph was too blurred to use.
entries.zh: 向导比较了鹨属两个物种的图画，因为那张照片太模糊，无法使用。

entries.en: The anti-abortionist listened to the student's question before explaining her position to the debate chair.
entries.zh: 那位反对堕胎者先听了学生的提问，再向辩论主持人解释自己的立场。

entries.en: He turned off anti-aliasing to compare the lettering with the original low-resolution image.
entries.zh: 他关闭了反锯齿功能，以便把字样与原来的低分辨率图像进行比较。

entries.en: The conference session on anti-angiogenesis ended before the final speaker could present her questions.
entries.zh: 关于血管生成抑制的会议分场在最后一位发言者提出问题前就结束了。

entries.en: The pharmacist called the clinic because the anti-arrhythmic on the prescription had no stated strength.
entries.zh: 处方上那种抗心律失常药未注明规格，药剂师因此打电话联系了诊所。

entries.en: The curator placed the broken kettle among works of anti-art, provoking an argument at the opening.
entries.zh: 策展人把那只破水壶放进反传统艺术作品之中，在开幕时引发了一场争论。

entries.en: His speech on anti-capitalism drew questions about the factory he had recently inherited.
entries.zh: 他关于反资本主义的演讲，引来了关于他最近继承的那家工厂的提问。

entries.en: The pamphlet branded the rival preacher an anti-christ, but the historian questioned its hostile account.
entries.zh: 小册子把那位对立的传教士斥为基督的敌人，但历史学家对这份充满敌意的记述提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 虎头蛇尾；令人失望的结尾
entries.en: After three chapters of pursuit, finding the stolen crown in a cupboard felt like an anti-climax.
entries.zh: 经过三章的追逐后，竟在橱柜里找到失窃的王冠，这个结尾令人失望。

entries.en: The technician set aside the anti-coagulant because its batch number did not match the order.
entries.zh: 那种阻凝剂的批号与订单不符，技术员因此把它放到了一边。

entries.en: The essay connected her paternal grandfather's letters with the anti-colonialism expressed in his unpublished poems.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把她祖父的书信，与他未发表诗作中表达的反殖民主义联系起来。

entries.en: The biographer examined his anti-communism without assuming that every later decision followed from it.
entries.zh: 传记作者考察了他的反共产主义立场，却没有认定他后来的每项决定都由此而来。

entries.en: The committee's report on anti-corruption included testimony from clerks as well as senior officials.
entries.zh: 委员会关于反腐败的报告既收录了高级官员的证言，也收录了办事员的证言。

entries.en: After the exhausting commute, half an hour in the garden became her favourite anti-depressant.
entries.zh: 累人的通勤结束后，在花园待上半小时成了她最喜欢的解忧良药。

entries.en: The nurse checked the label on the anti-emetic before asking the pharmacist about the unfamiliar brand.
entries.zh: 护士核对了镇吐药的标签，再向药剂师询问那个不熟悉的品牌。

entries.en: The journalist interviewed the anti-evolutionists separately, then invited a biologist to respond to their arguments.
entries.zh: 记者分别采访了那些反进化论者，然后邀请一位生物学家回应他们的论点。

entries.en: Her play explored anti-fascism through arguments between neighbours rather than speeches by famous leaders.
entries.zh: 她的剧作通过邻居之间的争论，而不是著名领袖的演讲，来探讨反法西斯主义。

entries.en: The anti-federalist in the classroom debate worried that the proposed government would weaken local control.
entries.zh: 课堂辩论中的那位反联邦主义者担心，拟议的政府会削弱地方的控制权。

entries.en: In the comic, anti-gravity keeps the village above the clouds until its engine fails.
entries.zh: 在漫画中，反重力让村庄悬浮在云层之上，直到引擎发生故障。

entries.meaningZh: 不具传统英雄特质的主角〔文学〕
entries.en: The novel's anti-hero hides during the rescue and later accepts praise meant for someone else.
entries.zh: 小说中那个不具传统英雄特质的主角在营救时躲了起来，后来却接受了本该给别人的赞扬。

entries.en: The mechanic found a loose connector while inspecting the damaged anti-icer.
entries.zh: 机修工检查受损的防冰器时，发现了一个松动的连接件。

entries.en: The speaker's anti-imperialism shaped his account of the port, but the students asked for more local voices.
entries.zh: 发言人的反帝国主义立场影响了他对那座港口的叙述，但学生们要求听到更多当地人的声音。

entries.en: The anti-imperialist refused to let the campaign use a map that erased the smaller communities.
entries.zh: 那位反帝国主义者拒绝让这场运动使用一张抹去了较小社群的地图。

entries.en: She criticised the programme's anti-intellectualism after it mocked a guest merely for consulting a reference book.
entries.zh: 她批评了那个节目的反智主义，因为节目仅因一位嘉宾查阅参考书，就对这位嘉宾加以嘲笑。

entries.en: She read the wrong column while looking up the anti-log in a printed table.
entries.zh: 她在纸质数表中查反对数时，读错了一栏。

entries.meaningZh: 反对英国加入欧洲共同市场的人〔历史用语〕
entries.en: In the classroom reenactment, the anti-marketeer challenged a businessman's optimistic forecast about joining the Common Market.
entries.zh: 在课堂历史情景重演中，那位反对英国加入欧洲共同市场的人，质疑了一位商人对加入共同市场的乐观预测。

entries.en: The student borrowed a book on anti-matter, then discovered that its final chapter was missing.
entries.zh: 学生借了一本关于反物质的书，随后发现最后一章缺失了。

entries.en: The exhibition linked the artist's anti-militarism with a series of unfinished drawings of empty barracks.
entries.zh: 展览把艺术家的反军国主义立场，与一组描绘空兵营的未完成画作联系起来。

entries.en: The chemist requested the supplier's data before approving a different anti-oxidant for the test batch.
entries.zh: 化学家要求先查看供应商的数据，才批准在试验批次中使用另一种抗氧化剂。

entries.en: The cap of his anti-perspirant came loose in the bag and stained his only clean shirt.
entries.zh: 他的防汗剂在包里松开了盖子，弄脏了他唯一一件干净衬衫。

entries.en: The columnist mistook her distrust of parties for anti-politics, overlooking her work on the local council.
entries.zh: 专栏作者把她对政党的不信任误认为反传统政治，忽视了她在地方议会的工作。

entries.en: The historical novel followed a clerk who abandoned the anti-pope after discovering a forged letter.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一名书记员发现伪造信件后，离弃那位对立教皇的故事。

entries.en: Her question about anti-psychotics led the pharmacist to arrange a longer, private conversation.
entries.zh: 她关于抗精神病药的提问，促使药剂师安排了一次时间更充裕的私下交谈。

entries.en: The students wanted their anti-racism to involve changes in school practice, not just a display of posters.
entries.zh: 学生们希望自己的反种族主义行动能改变学校的实际做法，而不只是张贴海报。

entries.en: His defence of anti-realism became clearer after he revised the example about an unobserved mountain.
entries.zh: 他修改了关于一座无人观察的山的例子后，对反实在论的辩护变得更清晰了。

entries.en: The anti-socialist on the panel nevertheless supported the proposal to keep the public library open.
entries.zh: 讨论小组中的那位反社会主义者仍然支持让公共图书馆继续开放的提案。

entries.en: The technician updated the anti-spyware while I searched for the missing installation receipt.
entries.zh: 我寻找不见的安装收据时，技术员更新了反间谍软件。

entries.en: The committee debated anti-terrorism alongside privacy, refusing to treat either subject as a minor detail.
entries.zh: 委员会把反恐与隐私放在一起讨论，拒绝把任何一项当作无关紧要的细节。

entries.en: The hospital questioned the anti-toxin shipment because its seal was broken on arrival.
entries.zh: 那批抗毒素运到时封条已破损，医院因此对该批货物提出了质疑。

entries.en: The clinic received the anti-venin in a damaged carton and contacted the supplier immediately.
entries.zh: 诊所收到的抗蛇毒血清外箱受损，便立即联系了供应商。

entries.en: The revised inventory listed the anti-venom separately from the empty containers awaiting disposal.
entries.zh: 修订后的库存表把抗蛇毒素与等待处理的空容器分开列出。

entries.en: The anti-vivisectionist asked the museum to explain why the old laboratory was being preserved.
entries.zh: 那位反对活体解剖者请博物馆解释，为何要保留那间旧实验室。

entries.en: Antia tied a ribbon around the dented tin so that it would look less ordinary as a gift.
entries.zh: 安蒂亚在凹陷的铁盒上系了一条丝带，让这份礼物看起来不那么普通。

entries.en: The antiabortionist declined the invitation because she disagreed with the event's rules for discussion.
entries.zh: 那位反对堕胎者拒绝了邀请，因为她不赞同活动的讨论规则。

entries.en: The trial documents identified the antiandrogen but omitted the manufacturer's contact details.
entries.zh: 试验文件写明了所用的抗雄激素物质，却漏掉了制造商的联系方式。

entries.en: The critic's book on antiart had a deliberately blank cover that confused the bookseller.
entries.zh: 那位评论家的反传统艺术著作特意用了空白封面，让书店老板感到困惑。

entries.en: The physicist removed the illustration of antiatoms because the caption referred to a different experiment.
entries.zh: 物理学家删去了反原子的插图，因为图注说的是另一项实验。

entries.en: Her antiauthoritarianism made her wary of giving one organiser control over every meeting.
entries.zh: 她的反独裁主义立场让她对把每场会议的控制权都交给同一个组织者保持警惕。

entries.en: The student checked the proposed antiautomorphism on every element before submitting the proof.
entries.zh: 学生在提交证明前，对每个元素都检验了所提出的反自同构。

entries.en: The antiauxin arrived after the experiment had been postponed, so the researcher revised the delivery record.
entries.zh: 抗植物生长素在实验推迟后才送到，研究人员因此修改了交货记录。

entries.en: The poet marked an antibacchius in the margin, then read the line aloud to test its rhythm.
entries.zh: 诗人在页边标出一个长长短格，再朗读那行诗来检验节奏。

entries.en: Her anticapitalism emerged gradually during arguments about who should own the abandoned mill.
entries.zh: 在关于废弃磨坊应归谁所有的争论中，她的反资本主义立场逐渐显现出来。

entries.en: Antich put the damp gloves near the radiator, forgetting that a concert ticket was tucked inside.
entries.zh: 安蒂克把湿手套放在暖气片附近，却忘了里面还塞着一张音乐会门票。

entries.en: The lecturer asked us to find a larger antichain in the same partially ordered set.
entries.zh: 讲师让我们在同一个偏序集中找出一条更大的反链。

entries.en: The geologists compared sketches of the two anticlinoria before planning their next survey.
entries.zh: 地质学家们比较了那两处复背斜的草图，才规划下一次勘测。

entries.en: The field party could not trace the anticlinorium farther because thick vegetation hid the outcrops.
entries.zh: 浓密的植被遮住了露头，野外小组无法继续追踪那处复背斜。
